scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:init
scripts.db:wait: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c "until pg_isready -U signal_app -d signal; do sleep 1; done"
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/000_init.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/001_auth.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/002_citizen_reports.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/003_dashboard_data.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/004_event_log.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/005_ticket_chat.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/006_user_preferences.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/007_volunteers.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/schemas/008_broadcast_updates.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/seeds/001_dashboard_seed.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U signal_app -d signal -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /workspace/database/seeds/002_dashboard_payload_seed.sql
scripts.db:init: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed:json
scripts.db:init:remote: npm run db:schema:node && npm run db:seed:json
